ValidationRule.description: Restrict editing fields: Assigned To, Start and End for Schedule_Seller record type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Schedule_Seller_Events ) , ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Schedule_Seller' ) , NOT( ISNEW() ) , OR( ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) , ISCHANGED( ActivityDateTime ) , ISCHANGED( DurationInMinutes ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Event_Type__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Event_Subtype__c ) , ISCHANGED( Subject ) , ISCHANGED( WhatId ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to modify this field for Schedule Seller Events.
